messages:
rachel: Heads-up: snippet validator failed on docs PR #4190. Errors look related to streaming pagination + retry kwargs. Anyone on deck?

ci-bot: CI failed: docs-snippets (validator) — 4 errors
ci-bot: logs:
```
Error: Unknown identifier 'cursor' in examples/ts/streaming/paginate.md:22
Error: deprecated param 'backoff' used in examples/py/streaming/retries.md:8
Error: line-too-long examples/py/streaming/paginate.md:95
Error: missing trailing newline in fenced block examples/ts/streaming/paginate.md:60
```

ben: I'll take TS. We changed paginate to return an AsyncGenerator in v0.9 so the examples must use `for await`. Looks quick.

nina: I'll handle Python. I noticed the SDK renamed StreamReader -> StreamCursor and changed retry param `backoff` -> `retry_policy`. I'll adjust examples and add migration notes.

olga: Go snippets are on me. InlineStream -> StreamCursor rename; Close() added, so we need defer cur.Close(). Also address long comment lines to satisfy lint.

nina: Python before/after (keeping minimal):
```
# before (sync)
it = StreamReader(client.stream("conv"))
for chunk in it:
    print(chunk.text)

# after (async + new name)
from redwood.sdk.stream import StreamCursor
cursor = StreamCursor(client.stream("conv"))
async for chunk in cursor:
    print(chunk.text)
```
Added small migration paragraph at top: "If you relied on synchronous StreamReader, switch to StreamCursor and use async iteration or the helper sync_runner() for compatibility."

ben: TS fix patch: replaced `for (const part of paginate(...))` with `for await (const part of paginate(...))` and added missing newline in the fenced code block. Also fixed the broken link pointing to /docs/pagination -> /docs/streaming/pagination. Pushed to PR.

ci-bot: Re-run started for PR #4190 (python, ts, go).

ci-bot: docs-snippets-go: PASSED
ci-bot: docs-snippets-ts: FAILED — lint: fenced-block missing newline examples/ts/streaming/paginate.md:64

ben: fixed newline and rebased. Also added a short comment in the TS snippet showing the old iterator pattern to help users searching issues.

olga: pushed Go tidy up: changed InlineStream usage to StreamCursor, added defer cur.Close(), and shortened a TODO comment to avoid line-too-long.

nina: pushed Python fixes and included a tiny compatibility helper note: `# sync compatibility: use run_sync(cursor)` example.

ci-bot: docs-snippets-python: PASSED
ci-bot: docs-snippets-ts: PASSED

docs-bot: Please add changelog entry: "SDK stream API: StreamCursor replaces StreamReader; paginate returns AsyncGenerator; retry param `backoff` renamed to `retry_policy`. See migration guide."

rachel: Great. Can everyone drop a short comment on the PR noting the changelog entry and any manual QA you did? I'll file a docs follow-up to monitor any customer confusion.

ben: did a quick staging render: https://staging-redwood-docs.internal/runs/4190/preview — snippets look good, code highlighting ok.

olga: looked at staging, Go snippet scrolling looks fine.

nina: verified python snippets run in the examples test harness locally.

rachel: Merged. Leaving a follow-up ticket on the docs board to check support channels for 48h. Thanks all for the quick turnaround :tada:
